title: sourcemap.json
description: Rendered geometry paired with source offsets, written alongside document.pdf whenever the document was rendered from source.md. This is what lets a comment anchored on a rendered page resolve back to a character range in the markdown the model wrote. docs/05-file-contracts.md names the file but does not show its shape; this schema is a W0-B design decision.

version.description: Format version. Readers accept a version they do not recognise by ignoring unknown fields.

documentId.description: The id from meta.json, so a stray source map can be matched to its document.

source.description: Relative filename the offsets index into. Always source.md today.

offsetEncoding.description: Unit of the range values. UTF-8 byte offsets are the only unit that means the same thing in Swift, Python, Go and Rust. A reader that finds a value it does not know must refuse the file rather than mis-slice it.

entries.description: One entry per laid-out text run. Finer is better: one entry per run beats one per paragraph. Order is not significant.

rect.description: [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the page, origin top-left, y increasing downwards.

range.description: [start, end) half-open UTF-8 byte offsets into the source file.
